exposure: Prelabour rupture of the membranes (PROM) at term pregnancy
cohort: The study included 98 women with a gestational period of 37 weeks or more who experienced prelabour rupture of membranes (PROM).
finding: Term prelabour rupture of the membranes is associated with significant maternal, fetal, and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery occurred in 69.4% of cases, while Cesarean sections were performed in 30.6% of cases, primarily due to fetal distress.
